title: Streamlining AI-Assisted Development with Laravel Boost
business: Development teams using AI coding agents to accelerate feature delivery.
problem: AI agents often generate non-idiomatic code or violate framework conventions because they lack project-specific context, leading to high maintenance costs and technical debt.
solution: Laravel Boost bridges the gap by providing AI agents with specialized tools and vectorized documentation, ensuring generated code adheres to Laravel's opinionated structure and version-specific requirements.
steps: Install Laravel Boost as a development dependency via Composer.
Execute the interactive installer to configure IDE and agent integration.
Define custom project-specific guidelines in the .ai/guidelines/ directory.
Allow the agent to utilize Boost tools to query database schemas and documentation.
outcome: AI agents produce consistent, idiomatic code that aligns with established framework patterns, reducing the need for manual refactoring.
limitation: Boost relies on the agent's ability to interpret provided context; if the .ai/guidelines/ files are poorly defined, the agent may still produce suboptimal code. Verify by reviewing generated code against standard Laravel conventions.

# Run the interactive installer to configure agents
php artisan boost:install
